direction: Japandi luxury: warm rice paper, sumi ink, Uji matcha and amber; Cormorant Garamond with Plus Jakarta Sans.

assets.prompt: Luxury editorial food photograph. Three tall golden Japanese souffle pancakes, ivory ceramic plate, melting butter, glossy maple syrup and delicate steam. Stack center-right, cream negative space left, warm morning light. No text.
Fluffy logo, rounded flowing lowercase wordmark, pancake-stack emblem, cream background and dark cocoa ink; Japanese souffle pancakes descriptor. Flat brand artwork.

One continuous food camera journey. 0-2s pancake stack gently jiggles. 2-6s push into melting butter, maple drip and aerated golden crumb. 6-8s extreme macro soft steam and warm bokeh. 8-13s reverse into same stack on ceramic plate in sunlit Tokyo cafe by garden window. 13-15s wide cafe. No cuts, people, logos or text.

assets.qualityReview: Usable macro-to-cafe film. Individual sequential pancake stacking was not achieved; correction rejected by provider daily generation limit. Initial floating-stack frames omitted from playback.
assets.requestedCorrection: Stationary empty plate; three separate pancakes land sequentially with soft bounce; butter melts; amber caramel pours. No truffle.

assets.review: Centered golden stack with matcha sauce and white chocolate cream, matches requested product.
